0.original: Erenville's gaze is fixed on the bandits' hideout.

24.original: Use the pouch of foul-smelling attractant at the designated location.

48.original: A fair number appear to be gathered inside. Now's our chance.

49.original: I will keep watch from here. The attractant I leave to you.

50.original: Toss it into the bonfire near the middle of town. The yeheheceyaa will come soon after.

53.original: What did you put in the fire!?

56.original: Someone wanna explain that ungodly stench to me?

62.original: Hmph, so the smoke's what drew them here? I swear, when I find out who did this...

63.original: I'd say our friends have stirred up enough trouble. Time to retrieve the bracelet.

65.original: (-Zekowa-)I'm still in here in case you've forgotten!

66.original: Sit tight. We'll be back for you.

67.original: (-Zekowa-)What!? You gotta get me out of here now! They're gonna kill me!

71.original: (-Zekowa-)Hey! Are you going to help me or what!?

72.original: <sigh> The bracelet must wait. Let's break him out and withdraw for now.

73.original: All that effort, and naught to show for it...

74.original: Sorry about that... But damn, I didn't think anyone would have the balls to take on the Vulture!

75.original: No need to apologize. We were planning to save you. Eventually.

76.original: Really? And I don't even know who you are. You secret admirers of mine or something?

77.original: Hehe, I'm just havin' fun with you. But I do appreciate the help.

78.original: This man they call the Vulture. I've seen his face before.

79.original: Was he not the officer you confronted in town?

80.original: The one and the same. When he's not masquerading as a gang leader, he serves as deputy chief of the Dustwatch.

81.original: That would explain why the bandits are so confident they can avoid capture.

82.original: You're trying to get back something the Vulture stole, right? Let me help. It's the least I can do after you bailed me out back there.

83.original: I have an idea where he's hid his cache. Reckon he's headed there now, too.

84.original: We can go together. I've got a score to settle with him myself.

85.original: I don't doubt that you do, but we need to know what it is first. Will you tell us?

86.original: Right, so. Those bandits at Tonatenyawi? They're called the Daybreakers, and it was me and my friends that founded the group...

87.original: B-But it wasn't a gang of cutthroats! Not back then...

88.original: We just wanted to protect people who couldn't protect themselves. Kids being harassed by bullies, workers being exploited by the mining concerns─folks who needed help to even the odds.

89.original: That was three years ago. And whenever we found someone scheming in the shadows, we settled matters the best way we knew how.

91.original: I see. By the old laws, anyone who loses in a duel must be held to account for their crimes, even those in positions of authority.

92.original: And we made damn sure they did, every time. Before we knew it, our small band of friends commanded a force to be reckoned with.

93.original: Then, about a year ago, the Vulture and his thugs showed up. They got the better of us and took over the Daybreakers.

94.original: Everyone was afraid of him, so they did his bidding without question. But when he showed them how they could make a fortune, easily─<hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103> was when he really won them over.

95.original: Now the Daybreakers is nothing but a bunch of bandits and cutthroats who prey on the people it was created to protect.

96.original: I talked it over with my friends, Kwikana and Liwine, and we all agreed the only way to stop him was to challenge him to a duel.

97.original: And he accepted. I still remember how he gloated that he'd win...

98.original: But when the day came, he showed up with the Dustwatch and had my friends arrested on charges of robbery.

99.original: As if that wasn't enough, he set their bail at a price no one could ever hope to pay.

100.original: With them locked away, there was no one left to help me. None of my old friends from the Daybreakers, and certainly not the Dustwatch...

101.original: And that's why you were ready to challenge him in the middle of town.

102.original: I was, until that guy with the spear stopped me.

103.original: No sooner had I stepped out of town than the Vulture's minions caught me by surprise. They took me prisoner, then...well, you know the rest.

104.original: You said the Dustwatch would be of no help. Are they all working for the Vulture, then?

106.original: The sheriff, Kemakka─he's as honest as they come, a staunch keeper of the peace. Problem is, he's a little too trusting and doesn't suspect a thing.

107.original: If it were my word against the deputy chief's, who do you think he'd believe?

108.original: Well, if he knows where this Vulture keeps his spoils, perhaps he can help us recover Namikka's bracelet. What do you think?

109.original: For what it's worth, I have a plan. But I can't do it alone.

111.original: All I ask is that you hear me out─but not here. I'll be waiting for you at Sheshenewezi Springs.

112.original: I guess we can decide what to do after he gives us the pitch.

113.original: Thanks, I owe you one. For a moment there I thought you might actually leave me behind.

115.original: This is where he hides his loot. I expect he'll show up soon.

116.original: I'm grateful he could take us to the deputy chief, but it will all be for naught if we're seen.
